name: speakers_list_avatar_candidates
title: List profile photo choices
description: App-only repair helper. Lists the current profile photo, prior profile-photo history, and the cropped reference-gallery candidates a human can choose from. Each candidate is a crop attributed to this person by reviewed subject geometry — never a whole frame — and carries reference_asset_id for speakers_avatar_mutate set_from_reference. in_matching_set says whether that crop is also used for matching; the two roles are independent. Returns image handles for the app; it does not change identity, voice memory, transcript labels, captions, exports, or merge state.

speaker_profile_id.description: Person public ID, slug, or UUID.
